This file contains entries for 245 registry packages in the recorded
Windows normal/build dependency tree (default features), with available
original license/notice texts for 245 packages; 0 remain unresolved.
It also retains host build-tool and procedural-macro notices
conservatively. Graph inclusion does not prove that all package code is
statically linked into the executable; no link map/unit-graph proof is present.

The wider metadata inventory has 269 registry packages. Its 24 entries absent
from the release tree are excluded, including the two recorded dev-only
packages. Cargo.lock contains 337 registry entries across a broader scope.

upstream originals (13 files), are identified with their URLs and hashes.

Metadata declarations for these entries have not been replaced with invented
copyright holders or generic license templates. The original collection had
8 declaration-only entries; 5 now have originals at the published VCS revision,
and 3 have originals from merged, license-only corrections directly based on
the published VCS revisions. Those 3 corrections leave all original source
blobs unchanged; their exact revisions and PRs are recorded in each entry.
The later corrections are not represented as originally archive-bundled files.
The three supplemented zune packages provide the complete Zlib alternative;
selection of an allowed alternative remains part of distribution review.

The MPL-2.0 dependency option-ext requires an explicit source-availability and
modification review. Its source locator is listed in its package section.
ring's Apache-2.0 AND ISC and unicode-ident's combined Unicode condition must
not be reduced to a single OR choice. All collected nested notices are kept.
Also review Apache NOTICE/modified-file conditions, Unicode notices, CDLA data
terms, and third-party/patent notices (including rav1e). This evidence assembly
is not legal advice or a claim of legally complete product distribution.

The surrounding application's own license, modified agent-browser source
notice, Rust toolchain/runtime, native platform components, and non-Rust
bundled components require their own product-level review. Public source
hosting/availability and downstream packaging have not been validated here.
This file alone does not clear those requirements.

https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/commands/cargo-tree.html

Cargo documents that normal/build tree output approximates a build graph;
it does not guarantee exact compilation equivalence. Names, versions, registry
sources and checksums are matched to the frozen Cargo.lock. 233 cached
crate archives independently match their Cargo.lock checksums; the remaining
12 are identity-mapped from evidence, without local archive-byte verification.
All 461 collected license-file hashes match the inventory. License original
bytes below are preserved, including original line endings and any byte-order
mark. Framing, package metadata and this introduction are added for clarity.
